subject: Melania, The Series
query: is melania the series the same as the movie
title: Is 'Melania, The Series' the same as the movie? What's different
answer: No. "Melania, The Series" is a separate two-episode docuseries that Prime Video releases on Friday, Nov. 20, 2026. It is a follow-up to "Melania," the documentary film that opened in theaters on Jan. 30, 2026. Both are directed by Brett Ratner, and Melania Trump is an executive producer.
body:
The film came first. "Melania," a documentary about Melania Trump in the period around the second Trump inauguration, premiered at the Kennedy Center in Washington on Jan. 29, 2026, opened in U.S. theaters the next day and began streaming on Prime Video in March. Amazon MGM Studios reportedly paid $40 million for the rights.

The series is new material in a different format. Amazon announced the premiere date and released a trailer on Nov. 6, 2026. It has two episodes, "Family & Trust" and "Pride & Honor." Prime Video describes it as an inside look at the first lady's life, including the days right after the 47th presidential inauguration. Early reports in 2026 had said the series would have three episodes; the final version has two.

Brett Ratner directed both episodes, as he did the film. Melania Trump and Marc Beckman are executive producers, and Ratner produces with Fernando Sulichin. Prime Video says the series will be available in more than 240 countries and territories. If you have already seen the movie, expect the same filmmaker and subject but episodes built as a separate release rather than a cut-up version of the film.

Amazon's spending on the film drew criticism when the deal was reported. The White House has denied that the projects were made for personal gain and has said the Trumps have never engaged in conflicts of interest.
in_the_news: "Melania, The Series" premieres on Prime Video on Friday, Nov. 20, 2026.
